body:
You recently bought a washing machine from a large electrical store. After two weeks it stopped working, and when you phoned the store you were not satisfied with the response.

Write a letter to the store manager.
bullets: explain what the problem is with the washing machine
describe what happened when you contacted the store
say what you would like the store to do

body:
Your flight home from a business trip was delayed by eleven hours and you missed an important appointment as a result. The airline has not offered you any help.

Write a letter to the airline.
bullets: give details of the flight and the delay
explain how the delay affected you
say what action you expect the airline to take

body:
You have seen an advertisement for a part-time weekend assistant at a local history museum.

Write a letter to the museum director applying for the job.
bullets: explain why you are interested in the position
describe your relevant skills and experience
say when you would be available for an interview

body:
Several street lights on the road where you live have not been working for over a month, and residents feel unsafe walking at night.

Write a letter to the local council.
bullets: describe the problem with the street lights
explain how this is affecting local residents
suggest what the council should do

body:
You are studying on a course at a college, but you have realised that it does not suit your career plans and you would like to transfer to a different course.

Write a letter to the head of admissions.
bullets: give details of the course you are currently taking
explain why you want to change
say which course you would like to transfer to and why

body:
You stayed at a hotel last week and, after returning home, you realised you had left a valuable personal item in your room.

Write a letter to the hotel manager.
bullets: give details of your stay
describe the item that you left behind
explain how you would like the item to be returned to you

body:
A local newspaper has reported that a park in your area will be replaced by a car park. You disagree with this plan.

Write a letter to the editor of the newspaper.
bullets: explain how you use the park
say why you think the plan is a bad idea
suggest an alternative solution

body:
You joined a fitness centre on a twelve-month contract, but you now need to cancel your membership. The centre says you must pay for the remaining months.

Write a letter to the manager of the fitness centre.
bullets: explain why you need to cancel your membership
say why you think you should not pay the full amount
suggest a fair solution

body:
Your town is holding an international music festival next summer and the organisers are looking for volunteers.

Write a letter to the festival organisers.
bullets: explain why you would like to volunteer
describe any skills or experience that would be useful
say which tasks you would prefer to do

body:
The local bus company has announced that it will stop running the bus service that you use every day to get to work.

Write a letter to the bus company.
bullets: explain how you use this bus service
describe the problems the change will cause
suggest what the company could do instead

body:
You ordered a gift online for a relative's birthday, but the item you received was different from the one you ordered and it arrived late.

Write a letter to the customer services manager of the online shop.
bullets: give details of your order
explain what was wrong with the delivery
say what you want the company to do now

body:
Your local public library has recently reduced its opening hours, and it is now closed in the evenings and on Sundays.

Write a letter to the head librarian.
bullets: explain how you use the library
describe how the new opening hours affect you
suggest how the library could improve the situation

body:
You recently had dinner at a restaurant for a family birthday, but the service was slow and you felt unwell afterwards.

Write a letter to the restaurant owner.
bullets: describe the occasion and what you ordered
explain what went wrong
say what you would like the owner to do

body:
You paid in advance for a ten-week language course, but after three weeks the school cancelled several classes without warning.

Write a letter to the director of the language school.
bullets: give details of the course you enrolled on
explain what problems have occurred
say what you would like the school to do

body:
The heating in the flat you rent has stopped working, and the weather has recently become very cold.

Write a letter to your landlord.
bullets: describe the problem with the heating
explain how it is affecting you
say what you would like your landlord to do

body:
You need to leave the flat you are renting before the end of your contract.

Write a letter to your landlord.
bullets: explain why you need to leave early
say when you would like to move out
suggest how you could help the landlord find a new tenant

body:
Your new neighbours have been holding loud parties late at night several times a week.

Write a letter to your neighbours.
bullets: introduce yourself
explain how the noise is affecting you
suggest a way to solve the problem

body:
A large tree in your neighbour's garden has grown so much that it is now blocking light and dropping leaves into your garden.

Write a letter to your neighbour.
bullets: describe the problem the tree is causing
explain why this is a concern for you
suggest what could be done about it

body:
You need to take two weeks off work at short notice for a family reason, and you want a colleague to cover some of your duties.

Write a letter to your colleague.
bullets: explain why you need time off
describe the tasks you would like your colleague to do
say how you will show your appreciation

body:
You have found a training course that you believe would help you in your job, and you would like your company to pay for it.

Write a letter to your manager.
bullets: give details of the course
explain how it would benefit you and the company
say how you would manage your workload while attending

body:
A colleague who has helped you a great deal is leaving your company to start a new job in another city.

Write a letter to your colleague.
bullets: thank them for the help they have given you
describe a time when their help was especially useful
offer to keep in touch and suggest how

body:
Your child will have to miss two weeks of school because your family needs to travel abroad for an important event.

Write a letter to your child's teacher.
bullets: explain why your child will be absent
say when your child will return to school
ask how your child can keep up with schoolwork

body:
One of your neighbours regularly parks their car in front of your driveway, making it difficult for you to leave home.

Write a letter to your neighbour.
bullets: describe the situation
explain the difficulties it causes you
suggest a solution to the problem

body:
You have been renting a flat for a year and would like to get a pet, but your tenancy agreement does not allow animals without permission.

Write a letter to your landlord.
bullets: say what kind of pet you would like to have
explain why you want the pet
describe how you would make sure the flat is not damaged

body:
You would like to change your working hours so that you can start and finish work later than you do now.

Write a letter to your manager.
bullets: explain why you want to change your hours
describe the new hours you would like to work
say how this change would not affect your work

body:
You are going away on holiday for three weeks and would like one of your neighbours to help look after your home while you are away.

Write a letter to your neighbour.
bullets: say when you will be away
explain what you would like your neighbour to do
offer something in return for their help

body:
You are a member of a local sports club and you have an idea for an event that would raise money for new equipment.

Write a letter to the club secretary.
bullets: describe your idea for the event
explain how it would raise money
say how you could help organise it

body:
You are getting married next spring and would like a close friend who lives abroad to come to your wedding.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: give details of the wedding
explain why it is important to you that your friend comes
offer to help with travel or accommodation

body:
You have recently started a new job in a different city.

Write a letter to a friend.
bullets: describe your new job
explain what you like and dislike about the city
invite your friend to visit you

body:
A friend lent you a book several months ago, but you have accidentally damaged it.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: explain what happened to the book
apologise for the damage
say what you will do to make up for it

body:
You recently spent a week staying at a friend's home in another country.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: thank your friend for their hospitality
describe what you enjoyed most about the visit
invite your friend to stay with you

body:
You were invited to a friend's birthday party, but you were unable to attend.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: apologise for missing the party
explain why you could not go
suggest another way to celebrate together

body:
A friend has written to you asking for advice about studying in the country where you live.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: give advice about choosing a university or college
describe the cost of living in your area
suggest how your friend can prepare before coming

body:
You have just moved to a new house in a different neighbourhood.

Write a letter to a friend.
bullets: describe your new home
explain why you decided to move
invite your friend to a house-warming party

body:
You have recently taken up a new hobby and you think your friend would enjoy it too.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: describe the hobby
explain how it has benefited you
suggest how your friend could start doing it

body:
You have not been in contact with an old school friend for several years, but you have just found their address.

Write a letter to your old friend.
bullets: explain how you found their address
tell them what you have been doing recently
suggest meeting up

body:
A friend from another country is planning to visit your hometown for a few days next month.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: recommend places your friend should visit
suggest the best way to travel around
offer to spend some time with them

body:
A friend has just passed an important exam after studying very hard for a long time.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: congratulate your friend
say how you think they should celebrate
ask about their plans for the future

body:
You are going on a trip and would like to borrow some equipment from a friend.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: explain where you are going and why
say what equipment you would like to borrow
say how you will look after it and when you will return it

body:
You are taking part in a charity run next month and would like a friend to join you.

Write a letter to your friend.
bullets: give details of the event
explain which charity it supports and why
persuade your friend to take part
